additional_info.subject: RE: ID0380566-DC/Si-D/IL-[dO2MQI] limitation of the charging power CRM:00798001304
additional_info.body:
Hi Orel,
We are suspecting limitation of Charging power is due to overheating of the charger,
in turn overheating is due to malfunctioning of the GQ1 fan.
And Insufficient circulation, Hence, Insufficient Cooling of the Charger to be in operational Temperature.
Hence, Derating of Charger.
Thank and Best Regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Giridhar "Gary"
